book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesu Manoga veize Ḡoꞌaniro
Iesuꞌa ḡoere eꞌe niduꞌa rae hauḡirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro,
“Zaꞌe edeḡa, mada aheu enogano Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa meꞌuma ebu Vaze Ubugaꞌe satauronoga veize agire ꞌevora riꞌiniꞌuma.”
Eꞌe madaḡano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa, niḡa Kaiafa neo nuꞌoraro.
Ebu ze Iesu soꞌonadu obone teadu manoga veize ibiḡa ḡoꞌane vaḡiro.
Rehano ze zeḡeꞌa bare reiro, “Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡanoꞌe mene idaḡa, mazaḡa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa utitofiꞌuma.”
Roḡae ꞌAhoganiꞌa Dehoro Hohoḡa Iesu rana Beuꞌiro
Iesuꞌe Betania neḡano ibite referaꞌa meiroteꞌe vazeḡa, niḡa Simona neo radiunu.
Aniꞌa ogomu fataḡa zamao tave ehoreꞌenaꞌa ogauꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, roḡae ꞌahoganiꞌa dehoro hohoḡa manoḡa naeḡa boroꞌe bioḡa komeꞌa manohuga iriꞌavonadu mae ariro, ebu Iesu vadinio beuꞌiro.
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa eꞌe horonirotene, ze maḡune rudaro ebu niro, “Nougadu dehoro hohoḡa ꞌahiꞌe mode hauḡeha?
Aꞌe hadi boro hina seronadu zahara azaḡa zinifo.”
Iesuꞌa eꞌe horonadu ziro, “Za nougadu roḡae ꞌadi aduga hauꞌohe? Aniꞌe eḡe veize manohuga haḡaeha.
Zahara azaḡaꞌe iḡaiḡa zae teite radiꞌuma, u eꞌe iḡaiḡa zae teite mene radiꞌuma.
Aniꞌe eḡeꞌa rudanadu guriteꞌe madaḡa ruhiboga veize dehoro hohoḡa eḡe ahiri rana beuꞌeha.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, raha niduꞌa zamaḡano noꞌe habaꞌano hari manoḡa haramine, aniꞌa haḡateꞌe haḡaiḡa ꞌahi meꞌodadu ani zamariꞌuma.”
Iudaꞌa Iesu Revohaꞌuma rae Ḡoitoriro
Eꞌe enogano Iesu tahiꞌaḡa gaubanana aheu fare boꞌaḡano tahiꞌa ꞌahoga, Isakariota vazeḡa Iudaꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa vaḡe onamiro,
ebu ḡadiziro, “E Iesu zae ꞌevoreo riꞌinine, za nagini iniꞌuma?” ꞌOugirotene ze hadi silivaḡa 30 meꞌodadu haro.
Eꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo aniꞌa Iesu zeḡe ꞌevoreo riꞌinoga veize mada manoḡa ꞌahoga vaḡiro.
Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa Ogomuḡa Aro

Isiti Oꞌoꞌa ꞌUvahuḡa Odoga Muiḡa zamaḡano mada ibiꞌaꞌe Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa. Eꞌe madaḡa meirotene, Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ane vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Ḡa urao eme Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ogomuḡaꞌe nouma ruhibe tiꞌuma?”

Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Ne boro diuḡadu vaze ꞌahoga vaḡoꞌi ebu noꞌi, 'Ihore vazeḡaniꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe: Eḡe mada ꞌai haniteha. E eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite ḡae neo Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ogomuḡa au tiburaꞌuma.'”
Eꞌanoꞌo Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Iesuꞌa ziroteꞌe idunaḡano Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ruhibe tiro.
Ḡoravararotene, Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare teite ogomu fataḡa babaḡano ehoriro.
Ebu ze ogauꞌeteꞌea Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa eḡe revoniꞌuma.”
Ebu ze zamaze adudanadu zeḡezeḡeꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eꞌe mene, ineo?”
Aneꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡe teite idaḡa siuvao ꞌevoꞌa tare auꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa revoniꞌuma.
Vaze Ubuga moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano mirihiroteꞌe idunaḡano Vaze Ubuganiꞌa rudaꞌuma. Rehano ani revohatiteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma. Aniꞌe mene furerafone ufeta manoḡa reifo.”
Ebu ani revohatiteꞌe vazeḡa, Iudaꞌa niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, eꞌe mene, ineo?” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Aꞌe ḡae.”
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa Ane Tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite Ogomu Ḡonaga Aro
Ze ogauꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, Iesuꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga madu kuraro ebu vahegadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziniro. Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “ꞌAdi madu anoꞌi. ꞌAdiꞌe eḡe ahiri.”
Ebu aniꞌa vaini vuḡa bioḡa madu kuraroteꞌe ḡarugano ziniro. Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “Zae niduꞌa, ꞌahi gagoꞌi.
Vaini vuḡa bioḡa ꞌadiꞌe eḡe ru. Aꞌe eḡeꞌa vaze ḡehaḡa haḡaize sauꞌa rae modoga veize ruhe beꞌunadu ohoneꞌeteꞌe ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, eꞌe vaini vuḡa mene bare gagiꞌuma, onamo eḡe Mamaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡano zae teite vaini vuḡa iziga gagiꞌuma.”
Ebu ze bada ꞌahoga mae hauḡadu Olivi Maḡa onamiro.
Peteroꞌa Iesu Oꞌoniꞌuma rae Reiro
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Izidi ohere zae niduꞌa eḡe muhihe feraꞌuma. Mazaḡa Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,
Rehano eḡeꞌa runeonoꞌo bare ḡaboditeꞌe enogano zae zamao Galilea habaꞌa onamiꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌa Iesu niro, “Vaze niduꞌa ferau muhiꞌiꞌuma rehano, eꞌe mene hune ferau muhiꞌiꞌuma!”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ḡaꞌohe, izidi ohere ꞌizema kokorokuꞌa uganogano ḡaeꞌa ḡae uḡidu eḡe oꞌohiꞌuma.”
Rehano Peteroꞌa niro, “E mene oꞌoꞌiꞌuma. Ḡae teite rudaune zuni idaḡa!” Ebu ane tahiꞌaḡa niduꞌa zuni ꞌouge reiro.
Getesemane Habaꞌano Kuraro
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite haba ꞌahoga, niḡa Getesemane onamadu ziro, “ꞌAda ehore radoꞌi, u eꞌe kuranoga veize ꞌomo onamiꞌuma.”
Ebu aniꞌe Petero ebu Zebedeo ubuga aheu, Iakobo zu Ioane tutuze onamiro. Ani zamaḡa ḡadahe ariro zu adudaro.
ꞌOugadu aniꞌa ziro, “Zamahe are rudauꞌohe. Zaꞌe ꞌada radadu eḡe teite evate radoꞌi.”
Ebu ani tahiḡa faḡa onamiro zu rahao ḡuḡuradu kuraro, “Eḡe Mama, ḡa idaḡa roꞌidene, eḡe mazaonoꞌo bio aduga ꞌadi mae vaḡinoꞌi. Rehano eḡe mene urao, ḡae urao daꞌo haḡaoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa vaḡe bare arirotene, ze bazeꞌeteꞌe horoziro. Ebu aniꞌa Petero niro, “Za mada tahiḡa zuni eḡe teite evate radoga mene idaḡahe?
Sataniꞌa tuhuzadu zaeꞌa mene uitifine tohutohoꞌi zu kuranoꞌi. Zamazeꞌe urateꞌohe, rehano ahirizeꞌe taoḡa.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa bare onamadu ḡae aheuḡano kuraro, “Eḡe Mama, e bio ꞌahi hube hune gage huniꞌuma roꞌidene, ḡae ura haḡaoꞌi.”
Aniꞌa bare arirotene, ze bare bazeꞌeteꞌe horoziro, mazaḡa ubumazeꞌa ufeta anoziro.
Aniꞌa ze muhizadu bare onamiro ebu ibite kuraroteꞌe teige ḡae uḡiduḡano bare kuraro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa vaḡe bare aradu ziro, “Za ꞌize bazeꞌehe zu ahirize ohoneꞌehe? Ḡiꞌanoꞌi, madaḡa ꞌai maha, ebu Vaze Ubugaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniꞌuma.
Iḡunadu onamihi. Ḡianoꞌi, eḡe revoniteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌai feureha.”
Iesu Obone Tiro

Iesuꞌa ꞌize ḡoereꞌeteꞌea, Iesu tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga, Iudaꞌa feuriro. Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe azaḡa ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa benisi zu somori boro madu Iuda teite ariro.
Ebu Iesu revoharoteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe aneꞌa nougenouge haḡaiteꞌe moneo ibite ihoziro, “Eḡeꞌa furaꞌiniteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Iesu. Ani obone toꞌi.”
Ebu aniꞌa zogone Iesu vaḡe onamadu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa! Manoḡahe?” Ebu aniꞌa furaꞌiniro.
Iesuꞌa niro, “Eḡe vaze, ḡa ꞌahao nagini haḡaiteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaoꞌi.” Ebu Iuda teite ariroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa onamadu Iesu obone tiro.
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesu ḡati vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa benisiḡa ahase bunadu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa tuḡure vazeḡa udirotene teḡaḡa variꞌe butiro.
ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa niro, “Benisiḡo bare iḡuꞌano ofoꞌi! Benisi hina vaze matihi raꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡe zuni benisi uꞌano rudaꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa Mamahe uminine, aneꞌa tuḡure viga ḡehaḡa bagaḡa zogone tuḡuzadu emeḡe biriꞌuma. Za eḡeꞌa ꞌouge uminoga idaḡa rae mene zamareꞌehe?
Rehano e ꞌougine, Buka Zaḡoḡano eḡe mazao ꞌahiguḡaniꞌa fureraꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa mene hudaꞌuma.”

Ebu Iesuꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ziro, “Zaꞌe ḡonore vazeḡa obone tiꞌeteꞌe teige, benisi ebu somori boro madu eḡe obohe touga veize arahe? Mada niduꞌa eꞌe kuru neḡa habaꞌano ihore radiunu. Eꞌe madaḡano zaꞌe mene obohe tiro.
Rehano peroveta azaḡaniꞌa mirihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudafine ꞌahiguḡaniꞌa fureraneha.” ꞌOugirotene ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa niduꞌaꞌe Iesu muhine feraro.
Iesuꞌe Kotao Ohoniro
Ebu Iesu obone tiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa Kaiafa vaḡe tutune onamiro. Eꞌea Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa nuꞌoranadu radiunu.
U Peteroꞌe faḡanonoꞌo Iesu hegotadu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa ne habaꞌano feuriro. Ebu naginiꞌa fureratiteꞌe ḡianoga veize ne habaꞌa diuḡadu eꞌe neḡa ḡianeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teite ehoriro.
Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Iuda azaḡa nuꞌonuꞌo boro azaḡaniꞌa Iesu manoga veize ani moneo ḡuriro ḡoeꞌaḡoeꞌa vaḡiro.
Ebu vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa aradu Iesu moneo ḡuriro ḡoeꞌa rae fureniro, rehano ze ani veꞌoḡaꞌe mene horoniro. Ḡonagano vaze aheuꞌa iḡune edaro.
Ebu ze ꞌahige rae fureniro, “Vaze ꞌadaꞌa raenaꞌa, 'Eḡeꞌa Badiꞌa kuru neḡa fahadu mada uḡidu zamaḡano bare ogoranogaꞌe idaḡa,' rae reiro.”
ꞌOuge reirotene, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa edau iḡunadu Iesu niro, “Zeꞌa ḡaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae fureneꞌohe. Ḡa zeḡe ḡoere mene naenaeniꞌumahe?”
Rehano Iesuꞌe sifu radiro. Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa niro, “E ḡabode radiuꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa niḡano riḡa ḡadimuꞌohe. Ḡaꞌe Keriso, Badiꞌa Ubuga ga mene? Efoꞌi.”

Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Oꞌe, ḡaeꞌa eꞌe Keriso rae raha. Rehano eḡeꞌa zae niduꞌa ziꞌohe, zama moneo Vaze Ubugaꞌe Gigiꞌa Boro Badiꞌaḡa edaꞌe moneo ehoradu zuhiꞌaziteꞌe zu adureo ḡoze hina ariteꞌe horoniꞌuma.”

ꞌOuge reirotene, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa dabuaḡa zegadu ziro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe Badiꞌa rae sausauneha! Eme aniꞌe veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa bare vaḡiꞌumahe? Izidi aniꞌa Badiꞌa rae sausaunateꞌe zae niduꞌa egeha.
Zaꞌe nouge rae zamareꞌohe?” Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Ani runeo tuḡuniꞌuma!”
Ebu zeꞌa Iesu iraḡa rana soꞌabide vaniro zu ꞌevoreze hina bouniro. Vaze nuꞌa ubumaḡa dabua hina ꞌuadu faꞌone arahiro,
“Keriso, efoꞌi. Iniuꞌa faꞌoꞌeha?”
Peteroꞌa Iesu Oꞌoniro
Ebu Peteroꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa ne habaꞌano ehore radiroteꞌea, tuḡure roḡaeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ane uꞌa aradu niro, “Ḡae zuni Galilea vazeḡa Iesu teite radiunu.”
Rehano Peteroꞌa zeḡe niduꞌa zamao oꞌoniro, “E ḡaꞌa nagini raꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa ne ḡabiriḡa ibihetaḡa uꞌa onamirotene, tuḡure roḡaeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa horonadu eꞌea radiunuteꞌe azaḡa ziro, “ꞌAdiꞌe Nazareta vazeḡa Iesu teite radiunu.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa bare oꞌonadu ḡoere rinede tiro, “Eꞌe vaze aꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa!”
Mada tahiḡa enogano eꞌea edau radiunuteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Petero vaḡe aradu niro, “Hube hune ḡa zu Iesu duḡuru boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga, mazaḡa ḡae ago iraḡaꞌe Galilea habaꞌa ago iraḡa.”
Ebu ani ḡoere rinede teadu reiro, “E ḡuririne aduga hidiꞌuma! E vaze aꞌe aḡuꞌa!” Ani Ꞌouge reirotene, kokorokuꞌa ugaro.
Ebu Peteroꞌe Iesuꞌa ꞌahige rae niroteꞌe zamariro, “Kokorokuꞌa ꞌizema uganogano ḡaeꞌa eḡe ḡae uḡidu oꞌohiꞌuma.” Ebu aniꞌa ne enogano buanadu niau rudaro.
